vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: A campus where every student can learn data science by doing, and graduate ready to turn data into decisions that matter.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Run hands-on workshops, project teams and competitions that take students from their first notebook to shipped work, and connect them with mentors, peers and opportunities.

objectives.title: Hands-on learning
objectives.description: Workshops and study tracks covering Python, statistics, machine learning and data engineering.

objectives.title: Real projects
objectives.description: Student teams that build and ship data and ML projects beyond coursework.

objectives.title: Competitions
objectives.description: Prepare and send teams to hackathons and data challenges.

objectives.title: Peer community
objectives.description: A welcoming space for first-years to final-years to learn together.

objectives.title: Mentorship
objectives.description: Guidance from faculty and seniors on projects, research and careers.

objectives.title: Opportunities
objectives.description: Internships, research openings and industry exposure shared with members.

specialPillars.title: Learn by Doing
specialPillars.subtitle: Practical exploration over theory alone
specialPillars.description: We bridge the gap between classroom concepts and production engineering. Students get hands-on with real-world datasets, reproducible notebooks, and end-to-end machine learning workflows.
points: Hands-on workshops covering Python, statistics, and machine learning
Building beyond coursework with real tools like PyTorch and FastAPI
Code walkthroughs and reproducible project architectures

specialPillars.title: Collaborative Peer Community
specialPillars.subtitle: Inclusive multi-year knowledge sharing
specialPillars.description: Learning is accelerated when done together. DSSA provides a welcoming space where first-years to final-years collaborate, exchange feedback, and tackle challenges as a cohesive team.
points: Welcoming environment connecting first-years with senior peers
Cross-functional collaboration across ML, development, and design pods
Open peer reviews and collective problem-solving sessions

specialPillars.title: Innovation & Hackathons
specialPillars.subtitle: Testing skills in competitive environments
specialPillars.description: We empower members to put their skills to the test in competitive arenas, organizing flagship hackathons like DataStorm and preparing student pods for national datathons and technical challenges.
points: Dedicated student pods formed for inter-college hackathons
Flagship hackathons and intensive domain bootcamps on campus
Practical experience building working prototypes under real constraints

specialPillars.title: Mentorship & Growth
specialPillars.subtitle: From first notebook to shipped impact
specialPillars.description: With guidance from faculty advisors and experienced seniors, members gain the technical rigor, project portfolios, and professional exposure needed for research and career milestones.
points: Faculty mentorship and research guidance from academic leads
Industry-aligned technical sessions and domain roadmaps
Portfolio-grade projects ready for research and internships

studentJourney.summary: Attend beginner-friendly sessions, build solid foundations in Python, statistics, and data exploration, and join our active student community.
Join specialized student pods, collaborate on real-world projects beyond coursework, and learn best practices in model training and deployment.
Participate in national hackathons and datathons, showcase project demos to peers and faculty, and contribute to technical research.
Step into coordinator and leadership roles, mentor incoming juniors, lead technical workshops, and expand DSSA's collaborative footprint.
